study.question: Can evaluation-only reuse of repeated target contributions in the existing compressed local scorer preserve the frozen joint model click AUC while reducing measured prediction time, with every learned Parameter and the complete training process retained?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: each of the30 evaluation scorer rows repeats the same target q in [q,k,q-k,q*k,a], and the first Linear independently recomputes its query-only contribution. A first-affine algebraic rewrite can reduce redundant operations without changing representation capacity or training. Real-arithmetic equivalence is a specification, not a BF16 equivalence result. Local trajectories constrain this direction: embedding12 lost AUC (0.6641111849 versus entry0.6667535475); narrower task heads and auxiliary sharing were not consistently useful; indexed routing and summary/evaluation specialization previously retained essentially the same AUC while lowering execution costs. The current incumbent is0.6671249391761293. Auxiliary shared_reuse reached0.6648248738 without clear inference improvement. Latest factorial reference/native-split/cart-fused/cart-split AUCs are0.6671249391761293/0.6670936618247224/0.6651833479093773/0.6652558044749190. This single-seed factorial supports initialization as a substantial confound of that branch and does not prove weight sharing beneficial or harmful independently. Therefore retain parameterization and all training, and test redundant evaluation computation directly. Available inputs here are public model sources, fixed batch API, runtime protocol and committed validation receipts, not local raw data or a training interface. Host-owned readiness/data verification and recipe are inherited by protocol hash, not independently rerun here. All inspected trials succeeded in execution; unsuccessful scientific directions are not execution failures. No prior runtime error is reported. No new architectural novelty or necessary-capacity conclusion is claimed.

study.proposed_difference: Four standalone modules: unchanged reference, repeated split arithmetic control, query-hoisted split candidate, and query-hoisted signed-weight merged candidate. Write original first-affine block weights as Wq,Wk,Wd,Wp,Wa. Reference computes Wq*q+Wk*k+Wd*(q-k)+Wp*(q*k)+Wa*a+b per slot. Split cells compute Wq*q separately, repeating or hoisting it. Merged cell computes (Wq+Wd)*q once per example plus (Wk-Wd)*k+Wp*(q*k)+Wa*a+b per slot. The original full weight/bias remains registered once; all slices/sums/cats are transient attached tensors constructed per call. The helper runs only in evaluation; training calls the original primary/auxiliary scorers verbatim. Pooling, counts and readouts are unchanged. All30 evaluation rows, including empty rows and the validation remainder batch, remain in order. Local checks passed: all modules syntax-compile without imports; exact CONFIG/constructor-default parity; imports equal reference and no direct I/O; other methods identical; constructor equals original after removing only mode validation/assignment/default; forward equals original after restoring its single evaluation call; three alternatives differ only in mode CONFIG/default; baseline/reference hashes preserved;570 exact-rational affine specification cases including zero/negative/cancellation inputs agree. No torch execution is available or attempted. These are source/specification checks, not tensor, BF16, optimizer or cost results. Missing rg/diff executables were handled with Python inspection; no installations or agents were launched.

Provisional efficiency acceptance additionally requires at least3% lower model-only p50 latency, no more than1% p95 regression, and at least2% lower full-validation inference_seconds against the contemporaneous reference at the frozen batch/hardware policy. falsifiers: Any inherited training state/gradient/RNG/one-step discrepancy beyond deterministic host noise, parameter-count/registration mismatch, hidden module state/cache, input or mask boundary violation rejects the implementation until diagnosed; do not interpret it as scientific evidence for factoring.

A reproducible quality loss beyond any frozen utility guardrail rejects that candidate utility. Failure of the tighter FP32/BF16 or1e-6 same-checkpoint AUC diagnostic rejects a strong function-preservation claim even if the looser utility gate passes.
No reproducible measured prediction-cost reduction rejects efficiency utility despite fewer logical MACs. Host tensor diagnostics marked not_requested or absent are unknown, not passes.

If hoisting succeeds but merging fails, the signed-weight rewrite is not useful under this precision; if both fail, this bounded implementation family is unsupported. Neither outcome proves all model capacity necessary or refutes all reuse schemes.
